rules.crop: L=min(W,H); integer half-open box inside native; clamp center origin to feasible interval containing ALL target polygons plus margin
rules.tie_rule: center origin=floor((dimension-L)/2); clamp independently on x/y
rules.raster: Pillow ImageDraw polygon round(x),round(y), union of ALL target-class polygons
rules.common: identical square crop; RGB LANCZOS->512; grayscale edit mask NEAREST->512
rules.sdxl: common RGB LANCZOS->1024; common mask NEAREST->1024; no padding
rules.mask_polarity: white=edit, black=preserve; gray=feather (pipeline mask binarization separately disclosed)
rules.semantic_gate: whole square UI/FOV/gray border; real normal-metal continuity; physical edge crossing; unannotated defects; all PENDING unless explicit new review
rules.rejection: pairwise exclusion, no replacement/target reduction/relaxation; >=4 sources and >=2 per class plus semantic review required
